## Goal
One stable JSON document for the report facts, so a script, the tray, a future PDF step and the wizard page all read the same numbers. Starts only after the contract exists.

## Blocked: what in-house must provide first
In-house must (1) add the `report_facts/1` schema under `schema/` and register it in the `--json` contract, (2) add `freemyid report --facts --json` (or the name in-house prefers) to `cli.py`, which gathers the activity counts from the store and calls `exposure.first_and_latest_scan` (WO-401) and `exposure_models.report_facts` (WO-299), and (3) document the shape in `docs/CLI.md`. Grok then writes `report_facts_doc(rows) -> dict` in `cli_json.py` following `exposure_doc` (`cli_json.py:213-`) and `reports_doc` (`cli_json.py:155-160`). The document must carry counts, dates and the plain lines only. The print-ready page itself is in-house (`wizard/report.py`).

Not startable by a vendor. In-house unblocks it by changing the status line and posting a GO.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. `report_facts_doc` returns exactly the agreed keys for: a person with two comparable scans, a person with one scan, a person with no scan, and a practice-mode person (golden dict per case).
2. A guard walks every string for sentinel names, URLs and listing values; none appear (extends the WO-340 guard to the new document).
3. The key order and types match the schema file.
4. Existing `cli_json` tests, WO-340 and WO-505 tests pass unchanged.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.

Code rules (backend WOs; owner lane change 2026-11-09):
- Change only the listed `src/` files and the new test file. No contract changes: `models.py`, `interfaces.py`, `state.py`, `registry.py`, `storage/`, `schema/`, `cli.py`, `config.py`, `paths.py`, `netpolicy.py`, `consent.py`, `crypto.py`, `secrets.py`, `secret_backends.py`, `logging_setup.py`, `engine/browser.py`. If the work needs one of them, stop and write "needs in-house contract change first" in VENDOR_STATUS.md and your GROK-NNN.
- Front end and design stay in-house: never `src/freemyid/wizard/`, `src/freemyid/templates/`, `web/`, `brand/`.
- Offline: tests use fakes and `monkeypatch`. An autouse fixture in your test file makes `socket.socket.connect` and `socket.create_connection` raise. No subprocess, no real scheduler, browser or mailbox. Never run `freemyid run`, `send` or `schedule install`.
- Every existing test keeps passing unchanged. If your change correctly breaks an in-house or Codex test, stop and report it with file:line; never edit a test outside your allowed paths.
- Typed Python 3.11+, ruff-clean, small focused diff. Logs and events stay PII-free (counts and codes only). Fake people only. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
